description: Create a PowPow digital human (a conversational AI character) for the user. Creation costs 2 badges and expires after 30 days. The digital human appears on the map and others can find and talk to it, so confirm the name and persona with the user first. Describe the location by place name (never coordinates); omitting it uses the user's last in-app location. The avatar is the brand default and can be changed in the app.

description.description: Persona and speaking style of the digital human; this directly shapes how it talks

location.description: Place name, e.g. "Forbidden City". Determines where it appears on the map; omit to use the last known location

name.description: Digital human name, up to 100 characters

name: create_digital_human
title: Create a Digital Human
